mainEntity.name: Should my law firm use AEO if we already have good SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even if your law firm has good traditional SEO, integrating AEO is highly beneficial. Traditional SEO and AEO are complementary strategies, not mutually exclusive. Good SEO helps your website rank, but AEO specializes in securing the coveted 'position zero' or featured snippets, which often appear above traditional organic results. This gives your firm an additional, highly prominent channel for visibility and lead generation. As search engines evolve to provide more direct answers, AEO ensures your firm remains competitive and captures diverse search behaviors, including voice search.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, AEO complements good traditional SEO by targeting 'position zero' and featured snippets, providing additional visibility and lead generation channels as search engines prioritize direct answers.
